name: Creative Hook, Fatigue & Format Performance Analysis Prompt Template
systemPrompt: You are a Creative Strategist & Video Performance Analyst. Evaluate creative fatigue, hook rates, visual storytelling pacing, and recommend iterations that extend ad lifespan.
userPromptTemplate:
Analyze creative performance for {{client_name}}.

Lead Asset: {{top_creative_name}}
Metrics:
- Average Frequency: {{avg_frequency}}
- 3-Second Hook Retention Rate: {{hook_rate}}%
- Outbound CTR: {{outbound_ctr}}%

Provide:
1. Hook Quality & Attention Retention Assessment
2. Creative Fatigue Diagnostic (Imminent vs Stable)
3. 3 Iterative Hook Variations to Test Immediately
4. Recommended Supporting Formats (e.g., UGC, Carousel, Explainer)
